text:
Alex (Marketing): Kicking off a quick sync on this weekend's paid push — search + retarget. Performance dipped Friday and we want a short, high-intensity refresh. TL;DR: shift ~20% daily search budget into retargeting surge, refresh creatives, widen retarget window. Thoughts?
Maria (Growth): +1. Do we have last 7d CPC / CPA by channel to justify the shift?
Devin (Ads): Pulling numbers now. 7d snapshot: Search CPC $2.10 CPA $110, Retarget CPC $0.95 CPA $68. Retarget impressions down ~45% due to audience cap.
Sophie (Creative): I knocked up 4 quick carousel hero variants — short copy + product screenshot vs stat-first. Will upload to Figma and share link.
Alex (Marketing): For bidding: propose retarget target CPA $75 and move to tCPA bidding; on search set a tROAS floor to avoid overspend. Add frequency cap 3/day on retargeting to fight fatigue.
Maria (Growth): We'll need consistent UTM conventions so inbound routing tags demos correctly. Devin can you standardize utm_campaign and utm_content?
Devin (Ads): Yep. I'll bulk edit final URLs and append UTMs like:
```
?utm_source=google&utm_medium=paid_search&utm_campaign=retarget_pulse&utm_content=rtg_feb_refresh
```
Also recommending expanding audience window to 60d and enabling LLA1 based on 30d converters to boost reach.
Sophie (Creative): Uploaded assets: https://www.figma.com/file/XXXXX — variants: V1='Build faster', V2='Lower inference cost', V3='Run in-prod today', V4='42% lower inference cost (case)'.
Alex (Marketing): Run A/B: V2 vs V4, 50/50 split, 7 days. Primary metric = demo requests, secondary = signups. If V4 > V2 by >=15% on demos, roll V4 across retarget + search headlines.
Maria (Growth): Also noticed mobile LP conversion dip on Friday. We should QA the CTA and form length before full push. I'll log a ticket with growth and dev.
Devin (Ads): Budget action plan: reduce broad search cap by 20% for 72 hours and route to retarget. Monitor hourly: if retarget CPA > 1.5x target for 2 contiguous hours, auto-rollback. I'll wire the alert.
Alex (Marketing): I'll draft the Slack announcement for tomorrow 9am with playbook and tagging for Sales/SDR routing changes. Also will add clear routing rule: utm_content=rtg_feb_refresh => route to SDR pool B.
Sophie (Creative): No objections. :thumbsup: I'll iterate creatives based on early signals (CTR + time on page).
Maria (Growth): I'll own the tracking sheet and update dashboard widgets (daily CPC/CPA + creative performance).
Devin (Ads): Added AdOps Bot workflow to execute URL swaps and alert on pacing anomalies.
Alex (Marketing): Perfect. Goal = 72-hour surge, then re-evaluate. I'll post the final playbook in #marketing once assets are live. Thanks team.
